_comment: VehicleStateService Gateway-ECU simulator (SWARCH-002 §1). vsomeip parses JSON strictly and ignores unknown keys; "_comment" fields below are documentation only, never read by vsomeip.

services._comment: SYS-002 §3.1: Service 0x1770, Instance 0x0001, TCP-only. The 30512 TCP port is a deployment-level choice not pinned by SYS-002; see SWARCH-002 §2.

events._comment: EvVehicleState, SYS-002 §4.2. is_field is a static vsomeip hint; the actual event type (ET_FIELD) is set programmatically in vehicle_state_service.cc's offer_event() call, which is authoritative here.

eventgroups._comment: EventGroupVehicleState, SYS-002 §4.2. is_multicast=false because SYS-002 §5.1 requires TCP-only delivery; no UDP/multicast event endpoint is configured.

service-discovery._comment: SYS-002 §5: SD TTL defaults to twice the event cycle (200 ms for the 100 ms EvVehicleState cycle). The SOME/IP-SD TTL field is a whole-seconds count, so this rounds up to 1. Set explicitly per SWARCH-002 §7 rather than relying on the vsomeip stack default (0xFFFFFF, effectively unlimited).
